Zulewski 1997 (grade B) assigned the highest clinical-score weights to dry skin, coarse hair, constipation, and cold intolerance, each with likelihood ratios near 2. The field is settled on antibody-driven etiology and lab thresholds (grade A evidence) while adjunctive interventions remain thin (one small trial).
